product.title: One API for every AI model, with your data under your rules
product.description: Lemru puts many AI models behind one OpenAI-compatible API. Pay with prepaid credits, and decide where your data may go: which regions, how long it may be kept, and whether it may be used for training.

oneApi.title: One API, many models
oneApi.description: Call models from different providers through one OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with one key.

credits.title: Prepaid credits
credits.description: Top up, then pay only for what you use. No subscription, and the price of every model is public.

dataPolicy.title: Your data policy
dataPolicy.description: Choose the regions your requests may be processed in, the longest a provider may keep them, and whether training on them is allowed. A request that no provider can serve under your policy is refused, not sent elsewhere.

evidence.title: A record for every request
evidence.description: Each request records where it was processed and the provider terms that applied at that moment, so you can show it later.

keys.title: Keys with limits
keys.description: Create a key per app or teammate, put a spending limit on it, and disable it at any time.

usage.title: Usage you can read
usage.description: See every request with its model, tokens and cost.

whatIsIt.question: What is Lemru?
whatIsIt.answer: One API in front of many AI models. You create a key, add credits, and call any model in the catalog with the same request format.

billing.question: How does billing work?
billing.answer: You buy credits in advance and each request is charged at the listed price of the model it used. There is no subscription.

compatibility.question: Does it work with the OpenAI SDK?
compatibility.answer: Yes. Point the SDK's base URL at Lemru and use your Lemru key.

dataLocation.question: Where does my data go?
dataLocation.answer: Only where your data policy allows. You choose the regions, the retention limit and whether training is allowed, and a request that no provider can serve under those rules is refused.

evidence.question: Can I show where a request was processed?
evidence.answer: Yes. Each request in your activity shows where it was processed and the provider terms that applied at that time.
